name: @pipeworx/mcp-exchange

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Get the current exchange rate between two currencies (e.g., USD, EUR). Returns the rate value and timestamp.

from.description: Source currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

to.description: Target currency code (e.g., EUR, JPY, CHF)

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at current rates. Returns the converted amount and the exchange rate applied.

tools.name: get_historical_rate
tools.description: Get the exchange rate between two currencies on a specific date (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the historical rate and date.

tools.name: get_currencies
tools.description: List all supported currencies with codes and full names. Use to verify currency codes before converting or checking rates.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-exchange forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the exchange pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
